q1_issues.issue: `(Future sk_arrival_1)` is unlicensed: the clause is present-tense ("is on Thursday") and "on Thursday" is an unanchored calendar adjunct with no TODAY supplied, so neither the surface-tense rule nor the futurate rule yields a tense atom.

q2_gaps: subjective "of"-genitive argument of a deverbal event noun ("the arrival of a delegation") — no rule says whether it attaches as a thematic role on the reified event noun or as Possession per the genitive section
copular "is <time PP>" predicated of an event-denoting noun — the light-verb rule covers occurred / happened / took place, not the copula
notes: Keeping the surface class `arrival` (rather than `arrive`) is what the inflection-only lemmatization rule requires, and the definite/indefinite split and Time term are right.
